Seed data:3, app_context.md reference paragraph, solution/app/src/db.js:127-133 and rules.js:17-21 agree. rules.js:31-47 calculates UTC anniversaries and :142-150 compares referrals to the supplied stored clock. Functional prompt P7/P8 and judge.toml:614,623,632,641,650 use explicit calendar/effective-time witnesses, not the run date. These are data instants, not fragile real-time waits. Runtime-index domain/results.json includes a successful local referral-date regression, but that is not a configured judge grade.

Adversarial assessment: an app using today's date for referral vesting would incorrectly mark both February 1 boundary referrals fully vested when run in October, while the explicit P8 fixed-reference expectations are 10000.00 versus 5000.00; a rescission app using the reference or action date instead of the operator's effective date disagrees with P7's 11/12/13-month probes. A conforming app may generate different record IDs, use different date presentation, or expose month selection through equivalent 100.00/100-unit controls: the criteria expressly allow those alternatives, do not grade current action timestamps, and specify no race winner/latency. No concrete false pass/false fail caused by the pins or clock instructions was found.
